function: LootTableBuilder (Create, IsRare, MaxRareChanceBonus, AddItem, AddGold, AddSpawnAction, Build)
description: What the loot table builder produces for a call sequence: the defaults of an item (largest quantity 1, not rare), gold as nw_it_gold001 with the amount as its largest quantity, a spawn action attaching to the item added last and a table id created twice replacing the first table.
inputs: Hand-written call sequences, one per row; the result lists each table built as id, rare flag, rare chance maximum and its items as resref/weight/largest quantity/rare/spawn action set, or the exception.
rows: T: rare false/max null/items [a/1/1/false/false, nw_it_gold001/2/10/false/false, b/3/4/true/false]
spawn action goes to the last item
A: rare false/max null/items [a/1/1/false/false] | B: rare false/max null/items [b/2/1/false/false]
same id twice replaces the first table
rare flag applies to the active table only
A: rare true/max null/items [] | B: rare false/max null/items [b/1/1/false/false]
